properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 22 at 12:41PM PDT until October 22 at 3:45PM PDT by NWS Hanford CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Kern County in central California...

* WHEN...Until 345 PM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways, especially Hwy 14, 178 and 395.  Some
low-water crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1237 PM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Overflowing poor drainage areas will cause minor
flooding in the advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Onyx, Walker Pass and Indian Wells Canyon.
- Inyokern and China Lake.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 345 PM PDT THIS AFTERNOON
